algorithm: The changes aim to reduce lost sales costs while keeping holding costs manageable: (1) Increased base_target to better handle high demand periods (2) Adjusted demand_multiplier to focus more on recent demand (3) Increased pipeline_weight to respond more aggressively to inventory gaps (4) Set a small min_order to maintain continuous replenishment. The higher weights and targets should reduce stockouts during demand spikes while the min_order prevents complete inactivity during low demand.
